name: Manticore
description: A legendary beast that has a human’s face, lion’s body, scorpion’s tail, and dragon’s wings.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The Manticore can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

abilities.name: Riddle Me This
abilities.description: The Manticore is obsessed with puzzles and can be distracted by brain teasers, word games, or other semi-intellectual diversions.

abilities.name: Winged
abilities.description: While airborne, the Manticore gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

abilities.name: Pouncing Attack
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to have the Manticore pounce into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20+6 physical damage, and the target becomes Shaky until they spend a Hope. While Shaky, the target makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

abilities.name: Paralyzing Tail Spike
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d8 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they overcome the toxin with a successful Strength Roll.

abilities.name: Locking Jaws
abilities.description: When the Manticore succeeds on a standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to lock their jaws onto the target, making the target Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (19).
